data.sender_name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen - Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd

items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of hunting licence application
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Letter is from a general authority (Kreis), so § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG (4-day rule for simple letters) applies, not the tax-office rule. Bescheiddatum (= posting date, no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date stated) = Thu 19.11.2026. Deemed delivery = 4th day after posting: 19.11.(day0)->20.11(1)->21.11(2)->22.11(3)->23.11(4) = Mon 23.11.2026. For a general authority this delivery day is not moved even if it fell on a weekend/holiday, but Mon 23.11.2026 is already a working day, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period counted per §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the Bekanntgabe day (23.11.) is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (a Wednesday, a normal working day in SH, no holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

items.title: Submit valid proof of hunting liability insurance to get the Jagdschein issued
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter sets no calendar date and no counted period for submitting the renewed insurance confirmation - it is an open-ended condition for the Jagdschein to be issued, not a deadline tied to any known start date. Therefore no exact due date can be computed; it should be done as soon as possible but is not itself time-barred by this letter and is independent of the Widerspruch deadline above.

warnings: The letter gives no fixed deadline for submitting the renewed insurance confirmation; only the one-month Widerspruch period against the rejection itself has a hard legal deadline.
